name: manual_3b5f83
claim: Before global heartbeat cleanup, stop affected workers, automatic restarts and queue mutations, and keep them quiesced until cleanup finishes; recheck the complete affected set under that maintenance window. If continuing quiescence cannot be established, do not run cleanup: the current implementation does not atomically recheck liveness before releasing each claim, so a restarting worker can lose its claim. Heartbeat cleanup now handles both legacy and queue claims for all agents classified DEAD, so verify liveness and independently inspect every affected claim before operator-authorized global cleanup; stale heartbeat alone does not prove death. Cleanup requeues queue claims even at the retry limit: hold exhausted or unsafe work and seek separately reviewed authorized recovery. An agent release event alone does not clear a queue claim. Queue completion requires queue complete <task_id> <claimant_id> and checks the current claimant; never impersonate an absent claimant. Verify completion artifacts independently, and remember a reserved handoff retains required_agent_id after requeue.

decisions.notes: Residual review 5848308801: prior confirmation alone cannot prevent a restart between DEAD selection and release; preserve ownership, retry and reservation safeguards and require continuing quiescence.

rationale: Residual review 5848308801: prior confirmation alone cannot prevent a restart between DEAD selection and release; preserve ownership, retry and reservation safeguards and require continuing quiescence.
